text.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ لَا تُؤَاخِذْنِى بِمَا نَسِيتُ وَلَا تُرْهِقْنِى مِنْ أَمْرِى عُسْرًۭا

baseline.text: Musa, Unuttuğum için beni sorumlu tutma ve işimde bana güçlük çıkarma, dedi.

findings.text: Musa unutmayı kabul edip bağışlanma istediği için ihlal öğrenme ilişkisinin içine geri alınabilir; bu tutum katılaşmış kaçınmadan farklıdır.
İşin zorlaştırılması, öğrencinin taşıma gücünün üzerine dışarıdan yüklenen bir ağırlık olarak tasvir edilir.

activation_trace.role: Accountability for an issued fault supplies the sanction the plea asks to suspend.
Loss from active recall supplies a non-deliberate mechanism for the breach.

changed_reading.after: A request to classify the breach by its mechanism: failed recall should not automatically count as culpable defiance.
changed_reading.before: A generic request not to be blamed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: لا تؤاخذني بما نسيت at 18:73 words 2-5.
baseline_models.mechanism: The accountability branch of ء خ ذ takes the failed-recall branch of ن س ي as its object: the speaker asks that loss of recall not be converted directly into culpable liability.

activation_trace.role: An imposed demand too heavy to bear supplies the pressure being refused.
The speaker's affair or condition is the domain on which that pressure would land.
Difficulty and severity name the constricted outcome of the imposed pressure.

changed_reading.after: Do not load my own situation with a demand whose imposed weight makes continuing prohibitively hard.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ولا ترهقني من أمري عسرا at 18:73 words 6-10.
baseline_models.mechanism: ر ه ق supplies imposed weight, ء م ر locates it in the speaker's own case, and ع س ر names the resulting constriction; the plea asks that discipline not make continuation unmanageable.

activation_trace.role: Negotiation concerning an affair supplies the social function of the utterance.
Accountability supplies the disputed consequence rather than a denied rule.
Deliberation over an affair supplies the proposed recalibration of its handling.

changed_reading.after: A compact renegotiation: preserve the learning relation while changing how this lapse is sanctioned.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قال followed by two coordinated prohibitions frames the whole ayah as a speech act.
baseline_models.mechanism: The negotiation branch of ق و ل and deliberative branch of ء م ر make the utterance a proposed adjustment to how the rule is administered: discipline is acknowledged, but the consequence of this breach is contested.

activation_trace.role: The focus lapse is the event whose significance is revised by the earlier sequence.
Accountability is the premature closure the speaker asks to defer.
An earlier loss from recall supplies the initiating omission in the route sequence.
The forgotten fish taking a path turns omission into directional movement.
Return to a prior location supplies the corrective reversal.
A remaining mark supplies recoverable evidence of where to return.
Following the trace supplies the method by which the omission is repaired.

changed_reading.after: Forgetting is also a recoverable marker; forbearance preserves the chance to retrace the error and regain direction.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier forgetting lets the fish take a path; return and trace-following then recover the sought direction. The focus lapse therefore becomes recoverable wayfinding information, so immediate liability could close the very process by which the error is corrected.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an omission followed by retracing and recovery; I infer lapse -> usable route marker -> reason to defer final liability, while the live alternative is that the first forgetting merely parallels the second without excusing it.
structural_cues: 18:61-64 orders forgetting, an unexpected path, recognition, return, and trace-following before 18:73 repeats a forgetting plea after the first objection.

activation_trace.role: Overloading with a demand supplies the pedagogical pressure to be calibrated.
Severe difficulty supplies the consequence of discipline outrunning capacity.
Following behind another supplies the learner's dependent position.
Capacity and ability supply the explicitly predicted limit.
Self-restraint supplies the performance the learner cannot yet sustain.
Complete cognitive enclosure supplies the knowledge the learner lacks.
Knowledge of an affair's interior supplies what would make restraint intelligible.

changed_reading.after: Do not impose the full disciplinary weight of comprehension before the learner has access to the knowledge that would make restraint possible.
changed_reading.before: Do not make this personally difficult.

context_deltas.mechanism: Following in order to learn establishes an asymmetric relation; predicted inability to restrain oneself is explicitly tied to not encompassing the event's inner account. The focus burden plea becomes a request to calibrate discipline to present epistemic capacity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies limited capacity plus incomplete inner knowledge; I infer epistemic deficit -> reduced ability to restrain objection -> need for calibrated sanction, while the live alternative is an unconditional rule whose breach is unaffected by understanding.
structural_cues: 18:66-70 places the request to learn, the capacity warning, the knowledge deficit, and the no-question rule before the first breach in 18:71-73.

activation_trace.role: Negotiation supplies the focus plea's function inside the companionship compact.
Accountability supplies the consequence being deferred once rather than abolished.
Failed recall supplies the limited ground for the requested reset.
Departure from obedience supplies the stronger category the speaker had promised to avoid.
Questioning supplies the specifically prohibited conduct.
A further question supplies the speaker's own trigger for termination.
Continued companionship supplies what remains conditionally at stake.
Reaching a limit supplies the cumulative threshold of forbearance.
A completed excuse supplies the point beyond which leniency is no longer requested.

changed_reading.after: Grant this lapse one reset; I am not asking to erase the rule, and repeated breach may properly end the companionship.
changed_reading.before: Do not hold this breach against me.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence distinguishes promised obedience, prohibited questioning, a first lapse plea, and a later self-imposed endpoint. The focus request is therefore one procedural reset inside escalating accountability, not a claim to permanent immunity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a rule, a lapse-grounded plea, and a later finite threshold; I infer first breach -> negotiated reset -> stricter next consequence, while the live alternative is that 18:76 is an unrelated fresh promise rather than a clarification of 18:73.
structural_cues: 18:69 promises no disobedience, 18:70 prohibits questions until explanation, 18:73 requests relief for the first lapse, and 18:76 sets the next-question endpoint.

activation_trace.role: The speaker asks not to be loaded with a demand that makes his affair too heavy.
The later explanation uses the same imposed-burden image for the parents' feared future.

changed_reading.after: His plea unknowingly voices the same burden-prevention logic later used to explain an action he presently cannot bear.
changed_reading.before: The speaker asks only for relief from his own immediate difficulty.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same causative root later describes the boy overwhelming his parents. The focus plea and the later explanation thus share a logic of averting intolerable downstream burden even though the speaker cannot yet see the teacher's scale or rationale.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated causative burden lexeme; I infer lexical echo -> shared preventive logic across unequal scales, while the live alternative is that the two burdens are independent and morally incomparable.
structural_cues: The identical ر ه ق root governs the speaker as object in 18:73 and the parents as object in 18:80; both scenes concern prevention of a worsening sequel.

activation_trace.role: The speaker's own affair supplies the local source-domain from which hardship might be made to proceed.
Deliberate action supplies the deed whose source is explicitly qualified.
The teacher's own affair is denied as the autonomous source of those deeds, activating the earlier possessive phrase.

changed_reading.after: Do not derive a crushing consequence from what is attributed to my own action; the ending later makes attribution of an act's source a central issue.
changed_reading.before: Do not create difficulty within my situation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing explanation denies that the teacher's deeds arose from his own affair, echoing the focus phrase about difficulty from the speaker's affair. This reactivates أمري as a question of attributed source and agency as well as personal circumstance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the possessive lexical echo and a final denial of autonomous action; I infer echo -> heightened agency/source contrast in the earlier plea, while the live alternative is that من أمري simply means within my circumstances with no retrospective source claim.
structural_cues: 18:73 has من أمري and 18:82 has وما فعلته عن أمري, with first-person possessive أمري at both the apology and the final disclosure.

remaining_uncertainties: بما نسيت can foreground involuntary failed recall or shade toward neglected obligation; the packet keeps both available.
The من أمري to عن أمري echo may activate agency and source, but it does not settle whether the focus phrase exceeds the ordinary sense of my situation.
The confiscation, insolvency, and load-lightening models are analogical branch activations, not proposed lexical substitutions.
strongest_changes: Forgetting becomes a retraceable route marker rather than only a mitigation of blame.
The plea becomes capacity-calibrated, one-reset accountability within a finite learning compact.
The later ر ه ق and أمري echoes align the plea with burden prevention and reopen the attribution of agency.
summary.what_was_special: Repeated focus roots carried the strongest activation: forgetting first redirects the journey, ر ه ق later names a feared parental burden, and أمري returns in the final denial of autonomous action. The split ق و ل to ق ل ل mapping and economic branches preserve contained readings that a conservative synthesis would likely lose.

activation_trace.role: Accountability supplies the ordinary focus sense being stretched by the later echo.
Taking and seizing supplies the material image latent inside that accountability form.
The king's taking of ships supplies a later concrete seizure parallel.
Taking by force supplies the limiting image of discipline becoming coercive possession.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily: do not let accountability seize the learner and his future in the way power confiscates what it can take.
changed_reading.before: Do not count this lapse against me.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because legal accountability is cross-read through later material confiscation; it remains anchored by the repeated ء خ ذ root and the packet's coercive غ ص ب branch, but downstream prose should present it only as an analogy about disproportionate discipline, never as a lexical translation of تؤاخذني as confiscate me.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تؤاخذني at 18:73 word 3 contains the taking root inside the accountability form.

activation_trace.role: Demanding from an insolvent person without gentleness supplies the pedagogical-debt image.
Payment for work supplies an explicit economy of what is owed for action.
Material need and low means supply the context image of inability to absorb an exaction.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily: do not call in the full debt of obedience and understanding from a learner who is presently epistemically insolvent.
changed_reading.before: Do not make the lesson difficult.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps pedagogy onto debt and subsistence; it remains anchored in the packet's ع س ر branch of pursuing an insolvent debtor and is activated by wage and poverty cues, but downstream prose should label it a social-economic analogy rather than a claim about literal debt.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عسرا at 18:73 word 10 carries a branch specifically about pressing a debtor in straitened means.

activation_trace.role: Smallness and reduction supply the utterance's imagined effort to lessen the sanction.
Carrying and rising under a load supply the speech act's attempt to make the burden bearable.
An over-heavy imposed demand supplies the load that speech tries to reduce.
Severe difficulty supplies the condition the utterance seeks to lighten.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the saying itself performs a bid to make the disciplinary load smaller and carryable.
changed_reading.before: He says a request for leniency.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ق و ل to ق ل ل mapping rather than the ordinary speech root; it remains focus-anchored because the mapped branches of diminution and bearing interact visibly with ر ه ق and ع س ر, but downstream prose should call it a sound-and-branch activation, not a lexical gloss of قال.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قال at 18:73 word 1 heads a plea about imposed weight and difficulty.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Forgetting requests eased accountability, not denial of breach.** `ق و ل` B001 externalizes Moses’ admission and plea. This echoes 18:24, where forgetting is answered by remembrance and nearer guidance, while 18:57 shows culpable forgetting after rejection. I infer that confessed forgetting keeps correction possible because it re-enters the social learning relation. The plea distinguishes reparable lapse from hardened evasion.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:76 preserved the distinction between confessed lapse and a knowingly breached final boundary.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Hardship as an imposed load on the learner’s affair.** `ر ه ق/B003` is coercive burdening beyond capacity; `ر ه ق/B001` is something covering or overwhelming. Forgetting supplies the admitted breach, while the second shocking event in 18:74, renewed prediction in 18:75, and self-imposed limit in 18:76 progressively tighten the load. I infer that Moses asks the teacher not to let one lapse determine the whole journey’s viability. `لَا تُرْهِقْنِي` reads as a request to keep correction proportionate so learning can continue.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:74–76 increased the interpretive pressure and then formalized a stopping rule, showing why proportional relief could only be temporary.

words.gloss_range: perfect speech verb introducing the quoted plea as a completed response in the dialogue sequence
words.prose: {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}) makes the plea an enacted speech response: the speaker does not merely feel regret, he voices it as a completed turn in the dialogue. The pro-dropped subject is recoverable from the scene, and the verb hands the speech root across the boundary from the prior rebuke into this apology; its qaf onset gives a firm sound before the plea softens. That opening also ties the utterance to the ayah's accountability, forgetting, and command-domain vocabulary, so the request arrives as spoken negotiation rather than private reflection.
words.root_gloss_range: speech, saying, and voiced assertion; locally it frames the following words as direct quotation rather than creating an independent lexical topic

topics.headline: completed speech frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the plea is introduced as a completed spoken turn, not as silent inner regret.
topics.reason: The perfect speech verb syntactically introduces the quotation and locally frames the rest of the ayah as direct speech.

topics.headline: speaker handoff in the dialogue spine
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a handoff from the previous speech turn to this response, keeping the exchange tightly dialogic.
topics.reason: The same speech-root pattern is presented as a same-surah dialogue spine, with a concrete boundary from the prior speaker to the present reply.

topics.headline: speech joins accountability and command language
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the opening speech frame gathers the coming claims about liability, forgetting, and personal domain into one voiced negotiation.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence rows are locally supported because the quoted content contains the accountability verb, the forgetting clause, and the domain noun.

topics.headline: hard opening sound before liability language
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can notice the firm acoustic onset before the softer plea unfolds.
topics.reason: The sound observation is local to the opening word and does not override grammar, but it adds a small audible payoff.

words.gloss_range: first prohibitive particle governing the following jussive and opening the backward-looking plea for leniency
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) is not ordinary description; here it governs the following jussive as a prohibitive request. Its scope is local to the accountability verb, so the first clause is a complete backward-looking plea over what was forgotten. Because another matching prohibitive follows, this first particle also begins a two-beat frame in which command grammar is softened into negotiated leniency.

topics.headline: first prohibitive governs one verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first negative particle is a request-forming prohibition aimed at one following verb.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark this particle as prohibitive with jussive governance over the following verb.

topics.headline: backward-looking first clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the first plea close around past forgetting before the second plea opens.
topics.reason: The first prohibition is a complete clause ending with the forgetting clause, so the temporal direction is locally coherent.

topics.headline: first half of repeated request frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the first reset in a repeated request pattern that turns command form into a plea.
topics.reason: The second matching prohibitive later in the ayah supports the repeated frame without collapsing the two clauses.

words.gloss_range: Form III jussive request not to hold the speaker accountable, with second-person actor and first-person affected object
words.prose: {{ar:تُؤَاخِذْنِى}} ({{tr:tuʾākhidhnī}}) puts the addressed party in the position of potential account-holder and the speaker as the directly affected object. The root's taking and seizure field survives as accountability pressure, even to the latent image of being captured by liability, but the Form III frame narrows it to relational liability rather than ordinary taking. The causal complement that follows gives the charge its basis, while petition echoes (2:286; 7:155) make the wording feel like a plea formula adapted into this dialogue; the nearby fish-scene memory contrast (18:63) keeps the forgetting claim concrete. The standard hamza creates an audible catch at the accountability verb, while the smoothing variant changes sound without changing the relation.
words.root_gloss_range: taking, seizing, receiving, capturing, and punishing; locally narrowed through Form III and the prohibitive frame into relational accountability rather than simple physical taking

topics.headline: jussive request with reversed roles
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sharp role routing: the addressee is the possible actor, and the speaker is fused to the verb as affected object.
topics.reason: The particle before it governs the jussive, while the suffix supplies the first-person object and the verb agreement supplies the second-person addressee.

topics.headline: taking root narrowed to accountability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the taking/seizure family behind the verb, while the local Form III request selects holding-to-account as the active sense.
topics.reason: The broader root range is real, but local grammar, Form III, and the causal complement narrow the payoff to accountability or liability.

topics.headline: Form III makes accountability relational
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the form casts accountability as a relation between two parties, not as an isolated act of taking.
topics.reason: The supplied form evidence identifies Form III and contrasts it with other taking forms without requiring those other forms locally.

topics.headline: petition formula across contexts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the wording as part of a petition formula also found in other requests for pardon (2:286; 7:155).
topics.reason: The rows give concrete references, and the local surface contains the same prohibitive accountability expression.

topics.headline: accountability paired with forgetting and speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that liability is not free-floating; it is tied to the spoken claim of forgetting and to the nearby fish-scene memory contrast (18:63).
topics.reason: The current ayah directly joins the accountability verb to the causal forgetting clause, and the supplied inter-ayah rows provide concrete comparison points.

topics.headline: variant smooths sound, not relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the hamza as a pressure point, while the accepted smoothing variant leaves the accountability relation intact.
topics.reason: The variant evidence affects phonetic texture but does not change the local grammar or semantic relation.

topics.headline: negative command after reproach
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the scene turn from being reproached to issuing a negative command-shaped plea back to the addressee.
topics.reason: The second-person jussive and first-person suffix make the reversal of address visible inside the word itself.

words.gloss_range: causal preposition attached to the accountability verb and fused orthographically to the following relative particle
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) attaches the accountability request to its cause: the speaker asks not to be held to account on account of what follows. Its local force is causal, not merely spatial attachment, and it opens a compact subframe with the following relative word. Later, the ayah balances this cause phrase with a separate domain phrase, so the plea moves from cause to domain before it closes on hardship.

topics.headline: cause attached to accountability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first plea gives a cause for leniency, not just an object after the verb.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the following relative phrase the prepositional complement tied to the accountability verb.

topics.headline: compact cause subframe
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the cause delayed and then opened through a fused preposition-relative unit.
topics.reason: The local spelling and syntax make the preposition and relative particle work together as the causal entry into the forgetting clause.

topics.headline: cause balanced with later domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah move from why accountability should not happen to where hardship should not be imposed.
topics.reason: The later domain preposition supports the row's two-stage logic without making the first preposition carry the later function.

words.gloss_range: open relative or masdar-forming particle that leaves the content of the forgetting broad while making the next verb explanatory
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) keeps the forgotten content open. It can be heard as the thing forgotten or as the forgetting event itself, and that ambiguity is useful rather than defective: the mitigation does not pin the lapse to one named object. The following verb explains the particle, so the cause remains broad but syntactically anchored.

topics.headline: open relative or event reading
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the plea can cover either what was forgotten or the fact of forgetting itself.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence supports a headless relative value, while the CRITICAL rows preserve the masdar-style event reading as a live interpretive pressure.

topics.headline: dependent explanatory clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the next verb does not start a new claim; it supplies the explanatory content for the causal phrase.
topics.reason: The local relative clause is syntactically forced, and the referent remains broadly recoverable rather than explicitly named.

topics.headline: same surface keeps content open
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the wording avoid a narrow object label at the center of the excuse.
topics.reason: The same surface can bear more than one particle analysis, and the cross-reference evidence warns against over-resolving the content.

words.gloss_range: first-person perfect verb confessing a completed lapse while leaving the forgotten object implicit
